description: Angular component for managing table columns assignment in import/export functionality, including dynamic column configuration based on entity type and validation logic.

classes.name: CsvColumnsDatasource
classes.description: Data source for managing CSV column parameters, utilizing BehaviorSubject for reactive updates.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes column types and device credentials based on entity type.

methods.name: columnsUpdated
methods.description: Updates column validity and disables options based on current column selections and entity type.

methods.name: isColumnTypeDiffers
methods.description: Checks if a column type requires a key for validation.

methods.name: columnValid
methods.description: Validates individual column based on type and key presence.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs overall validation of the component's columns.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the columns and updates data source.
